SELECT s.shipment_id, s.planned_departure_at, s.gateway_id,
s.cargo_name, s.departure_location, s.destination_location,
s.departure_latitude, s.departure_longitude,
s.destination_latitude, s.destination_longitude,
s.vehicle_number, s.driver_name, s.driver_phone,
s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at,
r.temp_min_c AS temp_min, r.temp_max_c AS temp_max, r.temp_hold_seconds, r.shock_threshold_g
FROM shipments s
LEFT JOIN judgement_rules r ON s.rule_id = r.rule_id
WHERE s.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.logger_id)
r.logger_id, r.measured_at, r.received_at,
r.temperature, r.humidity,
ROUND(r.battery_pct)::INTEGER AS battery_pct
FROM readings r
WHERE r.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
ORDER BY r.logger_id, r.measured_at DESC, r.reading_id DESC

SELECT alert_id, logger_id, alert_type AS type, detected_at AS occurred_at, extreme_value, threshold_value
FROM alerts
WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
ORDER BY detected_at DESC

SELECT r.measured_at, r.temperature, r.humidity
FROM readings r
WHERE r.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} AND r.logger_id = #{loggerId}
ORDER BY r.measured_at ASC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.measured_at)
r.measured_at, r.latitude, r.longitude
FROM readings r
WHERE r.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
AND r.latitude IS NOT NULL AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.measured_at ASC, r.reading_id DESC

SELECT a.alert_id, a.alert_type, a.logger_id, a.detected_at, a.extreme_value, a.threshold_value,
r.latitude, r.longitude
FROM alerts a
JOIN readings r ON r.reading_id = a.trigger_reading_id
WHERE a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
AND r.latitude IS NOT NULL
AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.detected_at ASC

WITH target_shipments AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s.shipment_id, s.gateway_id, s.cargo_name, s.departure_location, s.destination_location, s.vehicle_number, s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.created_at, s.departure_latitude, s.departure_longitude FROM shipments s ORDER BY CASE s.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'READY' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, s.created_at DESC, s.shipment_id DESC LIMIT 50 ),
alert_summary AS ( SELECT a.shipment_id,
COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE a.alert_type IN ('TEMP_HIGH', 'TEMP_LOW') ) AS temp_deviation_count,
COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE a.alert_type = 'SHOCK' ) AS shock_count,
COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE a.alert_type IN ('TEMP_HIGH', 'TEMP_LOW') AND a.status = 'OPEN' ) AS active_temp_alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN target_shipments s ON s.shipment_id = a.shipment_id
GROUP BY a.shipment_id )
SELECT s.shipment_id, s.gateway_id,
s.cargo_name, s.departure_location, s.destination_location, s.vehicle_number,
s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.created_at,
COALESCE(alert_summary.temp_deviation_count, 0)::INTEGER AS temp_deviation_count,
COALESCE(alert_summary.shock_count, 0)::INTEGER AS shock_count,
COALESCE(alert_summary.active_temp_alert_count, 0)::INTEGER AS active_temp_alert_count,
latest_reading.logger_id AS latest_logger_id,
latest_reading.temperature AS latest_temperature,
latest_reading.humidity AS latest_humidity,
latest_reading.battery_pct AS latest_battery_pct,
latest_reading.measured_at AS latest_measured_at,
CASE WHEN s.status = 'READY' THEN s.departure_latitude ELSE COALESCE( latest_reading.latitude, s.departure_latitude ) END AS marker_latitude,
CASE WHEN s.status = 'READY' THEN s.departure_longitude ELSE COALESCE( latest_reading.longitude, s.departure_longitude ) END AS marker_longitude
FROM target_shipments s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.logger_id, r.temperature, r.humidity, ROUND(r.battery_pct)::INTEGER AS battery_pct, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.measured_at
FROM readings r
WHERE r.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
ORDER BY r.measured_at DESC, r.reading_id DESC
LIMIT 1
) latest_reading ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN alert_summary ON alert_summary.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
ORDER BY CASE s.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'READY' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, s.created_at DESC, s.shipment_id DESC;

SELECT a.alert_id, a.shipment_id,
COALESCE(current_assignment.gateway_id, s.gateway_id) AS gateway_id, s.vehicle_number, s.cargo_name,
a.alert_type, a.status, a.detected_at, a.extreme_value, a.threshold_value
FROM alerts a
JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = a.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT assignment.gateway_id FROM shipment_device_assignments assignment WHERE assignment.shipment_id = s.shipment_id ORDER BY (assignment.unassigned_at IS NULL) DESC, assignment.assigned_at DESC, assignment.assignment_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) current_assignment ON TRUE
WHERE a.alert_type IN ('TEMP_HIGH', 'TEMP_LOW', 'SHOCK')
ORDER BY a.detected_at DESC, a.alert_id DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT rule_id, rule_name FROM judgement_rules WHERE enabled = 'Y' ORDER BY rule_id

SELECT
COUNT(*) AS reading_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT r.logger_id)::INTEGER AS logger_count,
ROUND(MIN(r.temperature), 2) AS min_temperature,
ROUND(MAX(r.temperature), 2) AS max_temperature,
ROUND(AVG(r.temperature), 2) AS avg_temperature,
ROUND(AVG(r.humidity), 2) AS avg_humidity,
ROUND(MAX(r.shock_g), 3) AS max_shock_g
FROM readings r
WHERE r.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

SELECT shipment_id
FROM shipments
WHERE vehicle_number = #{vehicleNumber}
AND status = 'READY'
AND gateway_id IS NULL
ORDER BY planned_departure_at ASC NULLS LAST, shipment_id ASC
LIMIT 2

SELECT shipment_id, vehicle_number, cargo_name, departure_location, destination_location, planned_departure_at
FROM shipments
WHERE vehicle_number = #{vehicleNumber}
AND status = 'READY'
AND gateway_id IS NULL
ORDER BY planned_departure_at ASC NULLS LAST, shipment_id ASC
